Ramhorn Rage
Instant2 min cooldown
Enrage Effect
Enrage party and raid members within 8 yds for 3 sec, regenerating 2% of their maximum health every 1.5 sec.

Melee auto attacks extend the duration of this effect by 2 sec, up to a maximum of 15 sec.

This ability empties your Tankard, consuming Fill Level stacks and triggering with a reduced cooldown based on stacks consumed.
Barbaric Rage
While enraged, the global cooldown of Barbarian abilities is reduced by 30%.
